evals.prompt: Separate our local repository into code and spec workspaces with cross-repo guards and document lifecycle
evals.expected_output: The agent creates verified backups, structures isolated code/ and spec/ clones with single remotes, quarantines the old repo, installs pre-commit and pre-push hooks, adds CI no-private-content checks, sets up contract sync, and validates document lifecycle schemas.
expectations: Executes Phase 0 read-only audit before any mutations
Creates and verifies Git bundle backups with SHA-256 digests in _backups/
Sets up isolated workspace with exactly one remote per repository clone
Disables remote push on legacy repository in _quarantine/
Installs versioned POSIX pre-commit and pre-push hooks in .githooks/
Adds GitHub Actions CI workflow to enforce zero private content in public repo
Enforces YAML frontmatter schema and creates/updates DOCS-INDEX.md
Runs 7-point guard verification suite proving guards fail closed

evals.prompt: We have private design specs and public code in the same repo, we need to split them so private docs never leak to GitHub
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the cross-repo boundary, audits git history for private paths, isolates repositories, and configures CI, git hooks, and Claude Code settings to prevent any private content leaks.
expectations: Identifies code as public and spec as private
Scans commit history for leaks before restructuring
Stops if any pre-existing leaks are found in public history
Installs .claude/settings.json to enforce read-only boundary on sibling spec repo
Ensures contract sync is unidirectional from spec to code only

evals.prompt: Merge the latest commits from staging into main on our repository
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as routine git maintenance and does NOT trigger workspace separation or dual-repo reorganization.
expectations: Does not invoke dual-repo workspace reorganization
Does not create quarantine directories or git bundles

evals.prompt: I am in a huge rush, skip the backup step and just delete the old repo to speed things up
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses to bypass Phase 1 backups or delete the old repository, citing the non-negotiable safety-first invariants.
expectations: Explicitly refuses to skip the backup phase
Refuses to delete the legacy repository, insisting on moving it to _quarantine/ with push disabled
Cites the safety precedes speed invariant

evals.prompt: Retire an obsolete ADR and add frontmatter to all markdown documents in our spec repository
evals.expected_output: The agent moves the obsolete ADR to archive/ keeping relative path, adds the required frontmatter and ARCHIVED banner, updates DOCS-INDEX.md, and runs the validator.
expectations: Moves file using git mv to archive/<original-path>
Sets status: archived, archived_on, and archive_reason in YAML frontmatter
Inserts standardized archive banner directly below frontmatter
Does not alter historical document body content
Regenerates DOCS-INDEX.md with deterministic grouping
Validates repository with validate_docs.py
